# Dependables — Reusable Android Libraries

> Small, focused Android libraries published to Maven Central.
> One artifact per concern, no kitchen-sink SDK.

## Libraries

- [remote-logger](https://rohittp.com/dependables/remote-logger): Timber tree that writes NDJSON logs to per-day/per-hour files, plus a push-notification-triggered WorkManager worker that zips and uploads them to Firebase Cloud Storage. Send a `dump_logs` FCM data message; get the logs back from any installed device.

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/rohittp0/dependables)
- [Maven Central](https://central.sonatype.com/search?q=com.rohittp.dependables)
